```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import joblib

cache_dir = Path("./_cache")
artifacts_dir = Path("./_artifacts")
cache_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
artifacts_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

memory = joblib.Memory("./_cache", verbose=0)

df = pl.read_csv("./data/scanner_data.csv", ignore_errors=True)

df = df.rename({
    "SKU": "product_id",
    "SKU_Category": "sku_category",
    "Date": "date",
    "Quantity": "quantity",
    "Sales_Amount": "sales_amount"
})

df = df.with_columns([
    pl.col("date").str.strptime(pl.Date, "%d/%m/%Y"),
    pl.col("quantity").cast(pl.Float64),
    pl.col("sales_amount").cast(pl.Float64)
])

df = df.filter(
    (pl.col("quantity") > 0) & (pl.col("sales_amount") > 0)
)

df = df.with_columns([
    (pl.col("sales_amount") / pl.col("quantity")).alias("unit_price")
])

panel_daily = df.group_by(["product_id", "date"]).agg([
    pl.sum("quantity").alias("quantity"),
    (pl.sum("sales_amount") / pl.sum("quantity")).alias("avg_unit_price")
]).sort(["product_id", "date"])

# panel_daily = panel_daily.with_columns([
#     pl.col("quantity").log().alias("log_y"),
#     pl.col("avg_unit_price").log().alias("log_price")
# ])

dates_obs = panel_daily.select("date").unique().sort("date")
dates = pd.date_range( start=dates_obs["date"].min(), end=dates_obs["date"].max(), freq="D" )
date_grid = pl.DataFrame({"date": dates}).with_columns(pl.col("date").cast(pl.Date))
product_grid = panel_daily.select("product_id").unique()

product_date_grid = product_grid.join(date_grid)

series_list = []
for product_id, group in panel_daily.group_by(["product_id"], maintain_order=True):
    group_pd = group.to_pandas()
    group_pd = group_pd.set_index("date")
    
    full_index = pd.date_range(
        start=group_pd.index.min(),
        end=group_pd.index.max(),
        freq="D"
    )
    
    group_pd = group_pd.reindex(full_index)
    
    group_pd["y"] = group_pd["y"].fillna(0.0)
    
    log_price_median = group_pd["log_price"].median()
    group_pd["log_price"] = (
        group_pd["log_price"]
        .ffill()
        .bfill()
        .fillna(log_price_median)
    )
    
    group_pd["log_y"] = np.log(group_pd["y"].replace(0, np.nan))
    
    group_pd["product_id"] = product_id
    group_pd = group_pd.reset_index()
    group_pd = group_pd.rename(columns={"index": "date"})
    
    series_list.append(group_pd)

panel_daily_filled = pl.from_pandas(pd.concat(series_list, ignore_index=True))

series_diagnostics = panel_daily_filled.group_by(["product_id"]).agg([
    pl.count().alias("n_obs"),
    (pl.col("y") > 0).sum().alias("n_nonzero"),
    pl.col("log_price").n_unique().alias("n_price_unique")
])

min_obs = 60
min_nonzero = 10
min_price_unique = 8

eligible_series = series_diagnostics.filter(
    (pl.col("n_obs") >= min_obs) &
    (pl.col("n_nonzero") >= min_nonzero) &
    (pl.col("n_price_unique") >= min_price_unique)
)

panel_daily_final = panel_daily_filled.join(
    eligible_series.select(["product_id"]),
    on=["product_id"],
    how="inner"
)

series_index = eligible_series.with_row_index("series_id")

panel_daily_final.write_parquet(artifacts_dir / "panel_daily.parquet")
series_index.write_parquet(artifacts_dir / "series_index.parquet")
```
